The Judgment was delivered by : K. T. Thomas, J.
1.  Two sex maniacs libidinously ravaged a tiny female tot like wild beasts and finished her off. Police after investigation found that the two respondents herein are those two fiends. A Sessions Court upheld the said police version as correct. He sentenced one of them to death penalty and the other to life imprisonment, but a Division Bench of the High Court of Delhi declined to believe the police version as true and consequently the two respondents were acquitted. This appeal by the State is by special leave.

facts: Two sex maniacs libidinously ravaged a tiny female tot like wild beasts and finished her off.
The little girl was Anuradha and she was aged only four.
She was fondly taken away from her mothers house on the forenoon of 5.9.1992.
Her dead body was taken up by her mother on the same night from the house of first accused Sunil.
When the doctor conducted autopsy on the dead body he described the dimensions of the imprints left in the infantile body reflecting a horrible sexual molestation inflicted on the child.

Next day the police arrested the two accused (A1-Sunil and A2-Ramesh) and after completing the investigation charge-sheeted both of them for offences under Sections 364, 376, 377 and 302 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
issues: Whether the two respondents are liable to be convicted for murder, rape and unnatural offence
petitioner_arguments: The prosecution has established the following circumstances: (1) Sunil (1st accused) had taken the child from the house of PW8 Tara by about noon on 5.9.1992.
The child was recovered from the house of A1 Sunil and she was then found breathless.
That child was lying naked by the side of A2 Ramesh who was in deep sleep when the mother of the child lifted her up.
A1 Sunil, who was then in inebriated condition, blurted out that Anuradha was sent to heaven.
respondent_arguments: The defence did not controvert the evidence of PW1 Dr. Basant Lal and no question was put to him in cross-examination by the defence counsel.
court_reasoning: The Sessions Judge has rightly accepted that evidence and no exception can be taken thereto.
The task of the court is narrowed down to the limited area i.e., were the two respondents the rapists or is there any reasonable scope to think that somebody else would have done those acts.
holding: The trial court convicted both the respondents and sentenced them as aforesaid.
